arguments.query: SELECT refund_ts, item_id, order_id FROM refunds LIMIT 3

SELECT p.category, COUNT(*) n, COUNT(DISTINCT r.refund_id) d FROM refunds r JOIN order_items oi ON oi.item_id=r.item_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id=oi.product_id WHERE strftime('%Y', datetime(r.refund_ts,'+8 hours'))='2025' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY n DESC
